results.snippet: Agriculture and livestock employ most Nigeriens and make up around two fifths of the economy, while Oil, uranium and gold are growing in importance. The Agadem fields in the east produce crude, which travels by pipeline, ~2,000 km, to the coast of Benin. A refinery at Zinder supplies part of the home market.
